notes.title: Before You Buy!
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone,

We came up with some information regarding Before Sunset 日落之前 in this little post. Keeping things short and sweet so you can quickly understand more about the game before you purchase! ːsteamhappyː

[h3][b]Project Introduction[/b][/h3]
Before Sunset is a 1.5 years indie horror game project created by 2 siblings. We have worked hard to ensure it is a major step up from our last project, Noctambulant, and that players will experience the fear and tension alongside with the story and lore.

[h3][b]Playtime[/b][/h3]
Through our testers & players, we have estimated an average range of 4-5 hours of casual gameplay!

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3] [No Spoilers] 
Before Sunset is packed with a lot of content. In this game :

[olist]
[*] You will solve puzzles, doing your best to survive, hide, run and stay alive.
[*] You get to explore the map as you like, choose to talk to different characters in game to learn about them and piece the story together, which we highly recommend.
[*] There will be lots of storytelling with hand-drawn illustrations.
[/olist]

[h3][b]Help[/b][/h3]
If you have any enquiries about anything regarding Before Sunset. You can post them in the discussion and I will do my best to assist you!

notes.title: Characters Lookout
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Before Sunset is launching today!

In this horror game, you are allowed to explore the entire place. There will also be multiple characters in the game. Feel free to talk to them, interact with various items, explore the place and learn about the story and lore of Before Sunset. 

I can't wait to hear what you think of the game. Here are 2 characters I have spotlighted for this announcement. See you soon and have fun!

notes.title: Launching Before Sunset
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

Before Sunset, our biggest project by far, is launching in two days!
It's been 1.5 years of hard work and development, and I want to thank everyone who has supported the game. We have gained over [b]500[/b] wishlists, which means so much to us!

We also have created 2 Game Trailers, posted on different timelines.

notes.title: Halloween Game Demo!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are all doing good! We are excited to announce that we are launching a short game demo for [b]Before Sunset[/b]. This short game demo has a very short little playthrough to spook up your Halloween!

Do keep a look out for our Halloween Game Demo which will be coming out very soon on Steam's Halloween Event on the 25th October!
